purpose: Distinguish bibliographic breadth from independently executable same-protocol coverage before any local main result is admitted, and keep every non-executable recent method visible without replacing it with an official score.

track_coverage.note: Methods may be registered on both WMA and Mem-Gallery. Union counts refer to unique method identities, not method-track executions. Causal-LoCoMo retains five deployable controls, but the recent CMI method identity itself is protocol-blocked from a main numeric cell.

blocked_method_policy.memory-r1: Keep visible as CODE_NOT_RELEASED until an official immutable revision contains executable method code.
blocked_method_policy.apex-mem: Keep visible as OFFICIAL_CODE_UNVERIFIED until an author-controlled implementation is verified.
blocked_method_policy.lightmem: Keep visible as OFFICIAL_CODE_UNVERIFIED; never substitute the unrelated zjunlp repository.
blocked_method_policy.hela-mem: Keep visible as LICENSE_BLOCKED until explicit permission or a compatible license is verified.
blocked_method_policy.cmi: Keep the 261 registered rows as PROTOCOL_BLOCKED with blank numeric cells; never relabel an oracle or label-aware run as a deployable result.

next_actions: Finish and independently accept the active WMA recovery2 sequence before starting competing server work.
Execute the 15 numeric-route methods only through their registered track-specific gates; a method on two tracks requires separate matched evidence on each track.
Re-audit the four source/license blockers only when new upstream evidence exists; do not pollute local tables with official values meanwhile.
Keep the eight different-task, different-benchmark, or literature-only methods in separate disclosure tables.
Run AgentEnhance only after each target track satisfies its predeclared recent-baseline gate.
claim_boundary: This audit proves registry accounting and route coverage only. It is not a reproduction, does not establish method quality, and authorizes no superiority or SOTA claim.
cleanup_boundary: No model becomes cleanup-eligible from registry accounting. Cleanup remains denied until every dependent track execution is terminal, accepted evidence and failures are archived, and the v3 ownership/no-reference gates pass.
